metadata.title: docs: fix manual testing instructions for Docker reachability and registration
metadata.author: Lang-Akshay

description:
## Summary

- Fix Section 14 (Manual Testing) to work correctly when the gateway runs inside Docker — translate processes must bind to `0.0.0.0` and registrations must use `host.docker.internal` instead of `localhost`
- Add missing `--expose-streamable-http` flag and explicit `"transport":"STREAMABLEHTTP"` field required for Streamable HTTP gateway registration
- Fix virtual server creation payload (wrap fields under `"server"` key) and export command (`HOST=localhost PORT=8080` env override)
- Clarify that MCP Inspector must connect to a virtual server, not a raw gateway; rename `SERVER_UUID` to `VIRTUAL_SERVER_UUID` throughout
- Add `make docker-prod && make testing-up` prerequisite block and consolidate JWT + BASE_URL into a single code block

commits.message:
Update manual testing instructions for Docker reachability and registration process

Signed-off-by: Lang-Akshay <akshay.shinde26@ibm.com>
